mapper.select: SELECT history_id, record_type, record_id, aggregate_root_type, aggregate_root_id, parent_history_id, current_version FROM t_business_change_record WHERE parent_history_id IS NULL AND ((record_type='CLIENT' AND record_id=CAST(#{clientId} AS CHAR)) OR (record_type='OPERATING_ENTITY' AND record_id IN (SELECT entity_no FROM t_client_entity_affiliation WHERE client_id = #{clientId})) OR (record_type='AGREEMENT' AND record_id IN (SELECT CAST(agreement_id AS CHAR) FROM t_agreement WHERE client_id = #{clientId} OR (local_partner_id IN (SELECT source_partner_id FROM t_entity_source_relation WHERE entity_no IN (SELECT entity_no FROM t_client_entity_affiliation WHERE client_id = #{clientId}) AND source_type='PARTNER') AND agreement_id IN (SELECT agreement_id FROM t_agreement_operating_entity WHERE entity_no IN (SELECT entity_no FROM t_client_entity_affiliation WHERE client_id = #{clientId}))))) OR (record_type='LOCAL_PARTNER' AND record_id IN (SELECT CAST(source_partner_id AS CHAR) FROM t_entity_source_relation WHERE entity_no IN (SELECT entity_no FROM t_client_entity_affiliation WHERE client_id = #{clientId}) AND source_type='PARTNER'))) ORDER BY history_id
